part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Television programmes
questions: Where do you usually watch TV programmes/shows? [Why?/Why not?]
Are there any programmes/shows you don't like watching? [Why?/Why not?]
Do you think you will watch more TV or fewer TV programmes/shows in the future? [Why?/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe someone you know who has started a business.
points: why this person decided to start a business
part2.closing: and explain whether you would like to do the same kind of work as this person.

topics.title: Choosing work
questions: What kinds of jobs do young people not want to do in your country?
Who is best at advising young people about choosing a job: teachers or parents?
Is money always the most important thing when choosing a job?

topics.title: Work–Life balance
questions: Do you agree that many people nowadays are under pressure to work longer hours and take less holiday?
What is the impact on society of people having a poor work–life balance?
Could you recommend some effective strategies for governments and employers to ensure people have a good work–life balance?

issues: Speaking Part 3 ('Choosing work'): the word 'not' in 'What kinds of jobs do young people not want to do in your country?' is underlined in the book; underline has no markup in the schema, so it is kept as plain text.
